summary: Frontend testing of Alert Notifications & Digests feature complete. Notification bell appears on all 8 authenticated pages (dashboard, pipeline, directory, workspaces, registries, mcp, team, audit) with clean layout under new sticky header. Bell dropdown opens correctly showing notification-panel with items or empty state. Mark-all-read, deep-link navigation, and settings gear -> /notifications all work. Notifications preferences page renders correctly: admin sees both 'My preferences' and 'Team defaults' tabs plus 'Send digest now' button; member sees only 'My preferences' tab and no digest button. Save operations for both mine + tenant produce success toasts and persist after reload. Digest run completes without errors. email-not-configured-banner is correctly absent (Emergent proxy configured).

integration_issues.issue: After clicking a resolve button on the Command Center, the unread badge did not appear (remained hidden). Existing 2 notification items were present but no new UNREAD notification was observed. Either (a) resolve API call did not trigger a state transition (alert was already resolved, or click did not effectively change state), or (b) notification was created but marked read immediately. Recommend main agent verify: alerts backend state transition on /api/alerts/{id}/resolve genuinely creates a new notification with read=false for the acting user or team members.

issues: Recharts warnings in console: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — chart container has zero dimensions on some render passes; cosmetic but log-noise

action_items: Verify alert acknowledge/resolve action reliably creates an UNREAD in-app notification (badge did not increment after resolve click in test run).
Fix Recharts container sizing warnings on Command Center dashboard (minor).
critical_code_review_comments: NotificationBell polls every 30s via setInterval — consider pausing when tab hidden (document.visibilityState) to reduce backend load.
Notifications.jsx: PrefEditor uses `prefs[c.key] !== false` for category default-true semantics; this is subtle — a missing key becomes true which is fine, but explicit defaults would be clearer.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All notification bell / preferences / digest flows validated via Playwright as admin and member. Only remaining concern is that resolving an alert did not appear to generate a new unread notification in the observed run — could be data-state dependent. To re-verify, drive a fresh alert transition on an OPEN alert and inspect unread badge + notification-item-* testids.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs found. Minor open question on notification-generation from alert resolve; likely data-state dependent (alert already in resolved state prior to click, so no state transition -> no notification emitted, consistent with problem statement).
